messages.subject: Reverse proxy and authorization
parts:
hi 

I have the shiny server configuration  file like this  and using the reverse proxying 

run_as shiny;
access_log /var/log/shiny-server/access.log default;

#disable_protocols websocket xdr-streaming xhr-streaming;

auth_proxy X-USER X-GROUPS;


location /sales/north{
         required_group tom;
    }

    location /sales/south{
          required_group harry;
    }

My expectation is that when  harry is trying to access the /sales/north he should get error that he is not authorized. But looks like when we have require_group defined at subfolder level this is not being honoured. It allows any user to access the reports.   How to achieve this ?


thanks
purushothaman
